context: Mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: カバー/臭い/クマ/思いっきり/水分/どっか/品物/大根

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、そのソファに、本気で、絶対、カバー、絶対、かけてね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you put the cover on that sofa, okay? Really, truly.
lines.style: Calm, direct instruction. Gentle but firm emphasis on the two repeated beats. Slight maternal lift at the end—not a question, but an affectionate certainty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、お靴、絶対、臭い、絶対、かもしれない
lines.en: Mom, my shoes might smell really bad…
lines.style: Quiet, sheepish confession. Soft attack. Quick pace until the trailing qualifier. Eyes down, a little mortified but genuinely worried about upsetting her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、クマ、絶対、目の下に、絶対、できてるわよ
lines.en: Sho, you've got dark circles under your eyes. Look at you.
lines.style: Observant, gentle reproof. Eyes narrowing with that particular mother-noticing. Warm but with a whisper of worry underneath. Not scolding—concerned.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お庭で、本気で、絶対、思いっきり、絶対、走ってきたよ
lines.en: Mom, I was running around really hard in the garden!
lines.style: Bright, eager explanation. Quick energy at the start. Proud of himself. Bouncing slightly in the delivery—six-year-old justification for the exhaustion.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、水分、絶対、こまめに、絶対、取ってね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you drink water regularly, alright? Don't forget.
lines.style: Practical instruction with maternal reminder. Even pace, attentive. The caring behind the direction is audible—she's looking out for him, not just giving orders.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お友達が、本気で、絶対、どっか、絶対、遊びに行こうって言ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, my friend said we should go play somewhere!
lines.style: Animated, hopeful pitch at the end. Quick energy throughout. Slightly bouncing on the words. A six-year-old offering news like it's a proposal.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、品物、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、選んでらっしゃい
lines.en: Sho, go pick out something with Dad, would you? Go on now.
lines.style: Warm direction with gentle pushing-off. Slight playfulness in the tone—she's encouraging him toward his father. The maternal instruction softened with affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、大根、絶対、お味噌汁、絶対、好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really love daikon in miso soup!
lines.style: Eager, intimate confession. Small and genuine. A child sharing something that delights him with the person he trusts most. Soft, unselfconscious.
